$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges California Resident James D. Crombie and his firm, Paron Capital Management, LLC, of Triburon, Calif., with providing false, fictitious, or fraudulent statements to the National Futures Association and with issuing fraudulent promotional materials.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges North Carolina Resident Toby D. Hunter of Waxhaw, N.C., and his companies, Prestige Capital Advisors, LLC (Prestige) and D2W Capital Management, LLC (D2W) of Charlotte, N.C.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Massachusetts Man Jeffrey Liskov and His Company, EagleEye Asset Management, LLC, with Committing a $3 Million Forex Fraud Fri, 09 Sep 2011 19:24:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6109-11.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) filed a civil complaint charging Jeffrey Liskov and his company, EagleEye Asset Management, LLC (EEAM), both of Plymouth, Mass., with cheating and defrauding at least one customer in the United States of over $3 million of retirement funds while trading off-exchange foreign currency contracts (forex) on the customer’s behalf.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Sues 11 Foreign Currency Firms in Second Nationwide Sweep Against Unregistered Firms Thu, 08 Sep 2011 15:09:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6108-11.html Cases bring to 25 the number of firms sued by the CFTC for failing to register under the 2008 Farm Bill, the Dodd-Frank Act and the CFTC’s regulations.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges North Carolinian Roy Scarboro, Jr. with Solicitation Fraud and Misappropriating Customer Funds in Forex Scheme Thu, 01 Sep 2011 21:40:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6103-11.html The CFTC filed and simultaneously settled charges that Roy Scarboro, Jr. of Archdale, N.C., fraudulently solicited approximately $713,000 from customers to trade off-exchange foreign currency.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Obtains Final Judgment against Italian National Carmine Garofalo Charged with Illegal Trading Wed, 31 Aug 2011 14:31:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6100-11.html The CFTC announced that the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois entered a final default judgment against defendant Carmine Garofalo, an Italian national who purports to reside in Tunisia, requiring him pay $614,925 in restitution and a $1,844,775 civil monetary penalty.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Chicago-Based Floor Broker Craig Taffel Pays $180,000 Civil Monetary Penalty to Settle Charges that He Acted as an Unregistered Futures Commission Merchant Thu, 25 Aug 2011 20:52:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6099-11.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) today issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges against Craig A. Taffel, a registered floor broker located in Chicago, Ill., for acting as a futures commission merchant (FCM) without being registered.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Chicago Futures Commission Merchant Tenco, Inc. Settles CFTC Charges that it Failed to Diligently Supervise and Placed Trades Without Proper Authorization Thu, 25 Aug 2011 20:19:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6098-11.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) today issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges against Tenco, Inc. (Tenco), a registered futures commission merchant (FCM) located in Chicago, Ill., for failing to diligently supervise its employees and agents and for placing trades without proper authorization from the account holder.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Orders Dearborn Trading, Inc. and Joel Bronstein of Chicago, Illinois to pay $180,000 Civil Penalty for Failing to File Pool’s Closing Annual Report Thu, 25 Aug 2011 19:46:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6097-11.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) today issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges against Dearborn Trading, Inc. (Dearborn), a commodity pool operator (CPO), and Joel Bronstein (Bronstein), Dearborn’s owner and principal, for failing to file a closing Annual Report (liquidation statement) for Dearborn Trading Fund, LLC, a commodity pool operated by Dearborn.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Douglas Elsworth Wilson and Three California Companies with Solicitation Fraud, Misappropriating Customer Funds, and Issuing False Statements in Multi-Million Dollar Commodity Futures and Forex Scheme Mon, 22 Aug 2011 20:46:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6096-11.html The CFTC announced that on August 18, 2011 a federal court in California entered an order freezing the assets of defendants Douglas Elsworth Wilson of Poway, Calif., and three California companies that he controls and manages, Elsworth Berg Capital Management LLC, Elsworth Berg Inc., and Elsworth Berg FX LLC. enfwilsoncomplaint07272011 enfdouglaswilsonorder


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Blue Sky Capital Management Corp. and Gregory M. Schneider with Making False Statements to the National Futures Association Wed, 10 Aug 2011 19:29:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6091-11.html The CFTC charged Blue Sky Capital Management Corp. of Lebanon, Tenn., and its principal, Gregory M. Schneider of Mount Juliet, Tenn., with making false statements to the National Futures Association.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Finds that St. Augustine, Florida, Couple and Their Company Defrauded Customers in Off-Exchange Foreign Currency Scheme Mon, 08 Aug 2011 20:18:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6090-11.html The CFTC obtained a federal court consent order finding that defendants Gary D. Martin and Brenda K. Martin of St. Augustine, Fla., and their company, Queen Shoals Consultants, LLC, defrauded customers in an off-exchange foreign currency scheme.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Orders Moroccan National and Former Citigroup Trader Otmane El Rhazi to Pay Over $1.49 Million for Unlawful Trading and Misappropriation from a Citibank, N.A. Klatch II of Tampa, Fla., and American Private Equity, LLC of Los Angeles, Calif., as well as three Commodity Pool Operators controlled by Klatch, ARM Capital Management, LLC, and TASK Capital Management, LLC), both of New York, N.Y., and Vigilant Capital Management, LLC of Center Valley, Pa.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases London-based Forex Capital Markets Ltd. Ordered to Pay $140,000 Penalty to Settle CFTC Charges of Acting as an Unregistered Retail Forex Exchange Dealer Wed, 03 Aug 2011 15:31:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6087-11.html The CFTC filed and simultaneously settled charges that Forex Capital Markets Ltd. of London, U.K. acted as a retail foreign exchange dealer (RFED) by conducting retail leveraged forex transactions with U.S. customers without registering with the CFTC under the agency’s regulation 5.3(a)(6)(i).

Davis of Jersey City, N.J. and St. Petersburg, Fla., David E. Howard II of Woodstock, Ga., and their New York companies, Forex Capital Trading Group, Inc., and Forex Capital Trading Partners, Inc., and Joseph Burgos of Rutherford, N.J., and his company, Highland Stone Capital Management, LLC, with fraudulently soliciting more than $1.3 million from at least 73 customers to trade off-exchange foreign currency contracts.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court in California Orders Ruben Gonzalez, Jose Naranjo, and their Company to Pay over $8 Million for Operating Ponzi Scheme and Misappropriation Thu, 28 Jul 2011 20:49:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6086-11.html The CFTC announced that Judge Otis D. Wright II of the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, Western Division, entered orders for default judgment and permanent injunction against defendants New Golden Investment Group, LLC of West Covina, Calif., and its principals, Ruben Gonzalez also of West Covina, and Jose Naranjo, formerly of La Mirada, Calif.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court in Illinois Orders Jay C. $urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Christopher L. Pia, Former Portfolio Manager for Hedge Fund Moore Capital Management, LLC, to Pay $1 Million Penalty to Settle CFTC Charges of Attempted Manipulation Mon, 25 Jul 2011 19:01:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6079-11.html The CFTC today issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges that Christopher Louis Pia of North Castle, N.Y., while employed as portfolio manager for Moore Capital Management, LLC, attempted to manipulate the settlement prices of palladium and platinum futures contracts on the New York Mercantile Exchange.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court in Texas Orders Jeremiah C. Yancy and His Company to Pay More than $2 Million for Foreign Currency Ponzi Scheme and Misappropriation Thu, 21 Jul 2011 21:41:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6077-11.html The CFTC obtained a federal court consent order imposing more than $2 million in restitution and civil monetary penalties on defendants Jeremiah C. Yancy (a.k.a. Jeremiah C. Glaub) of Atoka, Okla., and his company, Longbranch Group International LLC (a.k.a. Longbranch LLC) of Houston, Texas.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Ecoval Dairy Trade, Inc. Dawson to Pay $2.1 Million Penalty for Commodity Pool Fraud and Misappropriation Wed, 13 Jul 2011 17:40:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6072-11.html The CFTC announced that on July 5, 2011, Judge Virginia M. Kendall of the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois entered a supplemental consent order imposing a $2.1 million civil monetary penalty on Joseph A. Dawson of Fox Lake, Ill.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Robert S. Moss of North Carolina with Commodity Pool Fraud and Misappropriation Wed, 13 Jul 2011 16:11:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6071-11.html The CFTC filed and simultaneously settled charges that Robert S. Ortiz of Vero Beach, Fla., and his companies, Goyep International, Inc. of Vero Beach, Fla., and Royal Returns, Inc. of Hollywood, Fla.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges CIS Commodities LLC and Allen N. Ward with Misappropriation of Customer Funds and also Charges CIS, Ward, Trans Global Investments, LLC and Charles Leroy Timberlake with Misrepresentation and Issuing False Statements Fri, 08 Jul 2011 15:15:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6068-11.html The CFTC filed a civil complaint charging CIS Commodities LLC of Henderson, Nev., and its founder and president, Allen Nicholas Ward, of Aspen, Colo., with misappropriation of customer funds and misrepresentations and issuing false written statements to a customer. The complaint also charges Trans Global Investments, LLC, a Nevada company, its President, Charles Leroy Timberlake, of Plano, Texas, Ward, and CIS with misrepresentation and issuing false written statements.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Texas Federal Court Issues Order Freezing Assets of Mark Rice and His Houston Company, Financial Robotics Thu, 07 Jul 2011 16:08:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6067-11.html The CFTC announced that a federal court in Houston entered an order freezing the assets of Mark E. Giddens, Jr. of Fayetteville, Ga., and Anthony W. Dutton of Peachtree City, Ga., as well as commodity trader Michael Gomez of Valrico, Fla., for operating a fraudulent off-exchange foreign currency scheme in which they solicited and accepted approximately $1.4 million from the general public.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Grand Island, Nebraska Resident with Fraud and Records Violations in Connection with $4 Million Commodity Pool Thu, 30 Jun 2011 21:33:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6065-11.html The CFTC filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of Nebraska, charging Grace Elizabeth Reisinger of Grand Island, Neb., and ROF Consulting, LLC with operating a fraudulent commodity pool scheme.

$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Juvenal Machado and Florida-based Invers Forex, LLC with Defrauding Foreign Currency Customers of Almost $800,000 in Ponzi Scheme Tue, 28 Jun 2011 20:18:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6057-11.html The CFTC filed an enforcement action charging Juvenal Eduardo Machado and his Miami, Fla.-based company, Invers Forex, LLC, with defrauding approximately $786,000 from at least 28 customers, including Machado’s friends, neighbors and members of his church, through a retail foreign currency Ponzi scheme.

$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Revokes Registrations of Texas-based M25 Investments, Inc. and M37 Investments, LLC Tue, 07 Jun 2011 20:12:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6051-11.html The CFTC revoked the registrations of M25 Investments, Inc. and M37 Investments, LLC , of Waxahachie, Texas, as registered Commodity Trading Advisors.

$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Orders Moroccan Resident Richmond Hamilton, Jr., and Chicago Commodity Pool Operator Raleigh Capital Management, Inc. to Pay More than $4 Million in Restitution and a Civil Monetary Penalty for Misappropriation & False Statements to the NFA Wed, 01 Jun 2011 20:21:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6047-11.html The CFTC obtained a federal court order requiring defendants Richmond Hamilton, Jr., who lives in Morocco, and Raleigh Capital Management, Inc., a Chicago, Ill.-based registered commodity pool operator, to pay jointly and severally a $3,015,000 civil monetary penalty. The order also requires Hamilton to pay restitution of $1,005,000.

Theye to Pay More than $6.2 Million for Defrauding Investors in a Multi-Million Dollar Ponzi Scheme Thu, 26 May 2011 19:02:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6046-11.html The CFTC obtained a federal default judgment order requiring defendant Richard D. Welke and their Companies with $4.7 Million Fraud Thu, 26 May 2011 18:09:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr6045-11.html The CFTC filed an enforcement action charging Jonathan W.
